# Built Deployments folder  (`/__Deploy/`)

This folder contains LabVIEW code generated during the preparation of distribution packages.

* (Note: Files in this folder are automatically generated when you run `/__Build/Build VIHelpeks Deployment.vi`)*

* (Note: Content of this folder is pre-configured to be ignored by the `.gitignore` file.)*

The `/LV 14.0/` sub-folder will contain VIHelpeks VIs saved for LabVIEW 2014, which are used as the source to build the final `.vip` package.
